purpose: Controlar a integração automática de instrumentos promptuais nos três segmentos estruturais sem impedir o acionamento independente de qualquer instrumento habilitado.

integration_policy.specific_need_requires: instrument reference plus a non-empty reason explaining why participation in one or more protected segments is necessary for the current demand
integration_policy.default_behavior: Do not add newly discovered, mentioned, enabled, or selected instruments to the protected segments. Keep them available for independent activation and execution according to their own content and registered capabilities.
